title: Italian Parsnip Fritters
description: Crispy fritters filled with roasted parsnip and served with a side of tangy aioli. A creative Italian twist on traditional potato fritters.
instructions: Peel and dice the parsnip, then toss with 2 tablespoons of olive oil, salt, and pepper. Roast in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
In a large bowl, combine the flour, parmesan cheese, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs.
Once the parsnip is done roasting, let it cool slightly, then mash in a bowl with a fork.
Add the mashed parsnip to the flour mixture and stir until just combined.
Add the eggs to the mixture and stir until a dough forms.
Using your hands, shape the dough into small patties, about 1 1/2 inches (3.8 cm) in diameter and 1/2 inch (1.3 cm) thick.
Heat about 1/2 inch (1.3 cm) of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
When the oil is hot, add a few of the fritters to the skillet (do not overcrowd) and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Drain the fritters on paper towels and serve hot with a side of aioli for dipping.
